# Status

The behaviors that status calls, and each call that its examples make.
`osapi dsl chain get --name status` shows the same.

## Chain

|          |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Behavior | [status](../../behaviors/node/status/status.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Chain    | status → (hostname, uptime, os, load, memory, disk)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Calls    | [hostname](../../behaviors/config/hostname/hostname.md), [uptime](../../behaviors/node/uptime/uptime.md), [os](../../behaviors/node/os/os.md), [load](../../behaviors/node/load/load.md), [memory](../../behaviors/hardware/memory/memory.md), [disk](../../behaviors/hardware/disk/disk.md) |
| Used by  | none                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

## An Ubuntu host (get)

| CALL            | GETS                                                                         |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| status get      | disks=\[&#123;"free":31457280000,"name":"/","total":52428800000,"used":2097… |

| └─ memory get   | memory=&#123;"free":2147483648,"total":8589934592,"used":4294967296&#125;    |
| └─ disk get     | disks=\[&#123;"free":31457280000,"name":"/","total":52428800000,"used":2097… |
